title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 30
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．３０
overview:
Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 30 is a free Japanese demo disc from Sega that collects trial versions and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demos (one or two players):
- Waku Waku Monster
- Astra Superstars

Non-playable previews:
- Wachenroder
- Sol Divide
- Pocket Fighter
- Lunar 2: Eternal Blue
- Radiant Silvergun
- BackGuiner: Yomigaeru Yuusha-tachi Kakusei-hen "Guiner Tensei"
- Madou Monogatari

The disc also carries a text file with information about Waku Waku Monster.
